summary: chatui/README.md is mostly stale or duplicate; records one open question about its contradictions with the other docs.

ops.text: chatui/README.md says the chat UI connects to a "long-lived Executive Chef agent" and gives a local run recipe (install the root requirements, set `MCP_URL`, run `uvicorn chatui.app:app`), which contradicts the root README and CLAUDE.md (no long-lived agent, chatui has its own requirements and no MCP dependency, run `uvicorn app:app` from `chatui/`); the chatui README is presumed stale and needs confirmation.
ops.quote: The chat UI connects to the long-lived Executive Chef agent over a small FastAPI service
